content.text: It's a close one.

content.text: Exactly.

content.text: That was a close one.

content.text: I think we can take a lot from this and apply it outside of F1, right?
content.trans: 我认为我们可以从这个方面取很多，然后应用到F1之外。

content.text: Yeah.

content.text: All right, so let's listen to the dialogue for the last time and then we'll come back
content.trans: 好的，那么我们最后一次听对话，然后再回到这里。

content.text: and talk about this great sport.
content.trans: 和讨论这个伟大的运动。

content.text: Welcome back racing fans.
content.trans: 欢迎回到赛车迷。

content.text: My name is Rick Fields and as always I'm joined by my partner in crime, Bob Copeland.
content.trans: 我的名字是Rick Fields，我总是和我的罪犯搭档Bob Copeland一起工作。

content.text: We're in the last stretch of this very exciting race and Kimmy Rikonin is leading the pack
content.trans: 我们还在最后冲刺，里卡多·罗基尼正在领跑队伍。

content.text: with only four laps to go.
content.trans: 四圈剩下。

content.text: They're heading to turn three and Lewis Hamilton tries to pass Rikonin.
content.trans: 他们将前往改变三，雷诺·桑索试图超越里柯宁。

content.text: It's a close one and oh no Hamilton hits the wall.
content.trans: 这是一个非常接近的对决，哼哈兄弟们，他们终于在这一刻找到了胜利。

content.text: He came in too fast, jammed on the brakes and spun out.
content.trans: 他跑得太快，紧握方向盘，失控了。

content.text: We have yellow flag and the pace car is making its way out of the track.
content.trans: 我们有黄色信号旗，而赛车正在从赛道上离开。

content.text: The cleanup crew is towing the heavily damaged car and the green flag drops.
content.trans: 清理队正在拖着受损的汽车，绿色信号灯落下。

content.text: Rikonin is still in the lead with only two laps to go.
content.trans: 李冠宁目前仍领先，还有两圈要跑。

content.text: Smoke is coming out of his car.
content.trans: 烟从他的车子里冒出来。

content.text: He seems to be having engine trouble.
content.trans: 他似乎正在经历发动机问题。

content.text: He makes his way out of the pit and for none, no one else will take the lead.
content.trans: 他走出坑洞，没有人能代替他。

content.text: How unlucky for Rikonin and this race is over ladies and gentlemen.
content.trans: 恭喜罗金尼，这个比赛已经结束了。

content.text: Alonso takes the checkered flag.
content.trans: 在阿里山取了国旗。

content.text: All right, so F1 racing, Erica, do you like it?
content.trans: 好的，所以F1赛车，艾瑞卡，你喜欢吗？

content.text: Do you watch it?
content.trans: 是的，你观看它吗？

content.text: Cars that drive fast, that's pretty interesting.

content.trans: 为什么我想要参加比赛，只是想看看快车？

content.trans: 我绝对不会参加比赛，但我认为我可能会在电视上观看比赛的精彩片段。

content.text: Well actually this year it's really exciting because again we're going to have a night race.
content.trans: 实际上，今年真的非常激动，因为我们将再次举行夜跑比赛。

content.text: I think it's in Malaysia or somewhere in Asia.
content.trans: 我认为在马来西亚或亚洲其他地方。

content.text: They're going to race at night.
content.trans: 他们将在夜晚进行比赛。

content.text: So that's pretty special huh?
content.trans: 所以，这真是特别吗？

content.text: Well it's like harder to see and you're going really fast.
content.trans: 嗯，看起来很难看，你走得很快。

content.text: Imagine.

content.trans: 好的，所以今年我要去F1。

content.trans: 是的，今年我打算去上海赛道观看F1比赛，所以我真的很期待。

content.text: excited about that.
content.trans: 高兴地对那个感到兴奋。

content.text: I haven't ever been to one so it should be fun.
content.trans: 我从未去过，所以应该很有趣。

content.text: All right, well I hope you get to see some interesting things like car crashes and pace
content.trans: 好的，我希望你能看到一些有趣的 things，比如车祸和速度。

content.text: cars.

content.text: Send us your questions and comments and also your stories.
content.trans: 请将您的问题和评论发给我，同时分享您的故事。

content.trans: 我们巴西有很多听众，我知道那里有一个大奖赛。
